purpose: Preserve the terminal outcome of the sole Tushare initial-report single-quarter gross-margin year-over-year source attempt after its small acceptance passed but its atomic full-market snapshot encountered one invalid required source row.

mechanism.name: tushare_single_quarter_gross_margin_yoy_change
mechanism.availability: first local trading session strictly after the current initial ann_date
mechanism.revision_policy: update_flag=0 initial rows only; update_flag=1 revised rows are count-only and never used or persisted

accepted_probe_context.interpretation: The three-stock probe proved entitlement, exact five-field schema, initial-only handling, and the local formula, but did not waive the independently frozen full-source gate.

full_source_attempt.failure: One returned row had an invalid or incomplete required stock code, announcement date, report period, or update_flag.
full_source_attempt.reason_field_level_identity_is_unknown: Raw provider frames and source margin levels were never persisted, and the one-shot contract does not authorize re-requesting the failed stock to recover unavailable field detail.

proven: The all-or-nothing implementation issued only the two frozen report-period slices and five-field whitelist, then stopped on the first invalid required source row.
The temporary full snapshot was deleted and no annual Parquet partition or full manifest was published.
No revised value, source margin level, price, forward return, score, selection, sizing, or order was used or persisted.
not_proven: which one of the four required key/version fields was invalid on the unavailable source row
near-synonym independence from quarterly quality fields
historical association, execution-aware returns, aggregation, current scoring, selection, sizing, or trading performance
interpretation.economic_classification: The idea remains economically interpretable, but this exact public-source route failed its predeclared reproducibility gate and contributes no admitted factor.

terminal_decision.next_authorized_action: Re-audit the no-return mechanism frontier and, if any candidate remains, freeze a newly economically independent source contract before provider rows or factor values.
